job: Resolve one project and role into a verified checkout identity, its exact source head, and the closed runtime binding it may consume, and return that as one typed route receipt.

refs.purpose: The portable route declaration; the only route authority.
The hydrated route this machine projects the declaration onto.
Machine identity and the sealed roster, bound by name.
Port projection when the caller consumes the runtime.
Runtime owner registry, bound only when runtimeNeed is consume.
This step's own receipt, and beside it every artifact the Sequence names; the folder input.project.artifactRootRef must equal.

sideEffects: write only the typed route receipt under input.artifactRootRef
write ignored machine-local hydrated route state for the resolved project and role
forbiddenSideEffects: accept a similar name, a sibling directory, the current working directory, or a browser URL as route authority
accept a caller-selected URL, loopback alias, or merely listening port as an endpoint
start, stop, restart, replace, or kill a shared runtime process
claim a port, PID, or runtime lifecycle for a feature task
create or switch to a task, feature, or worktree branch under a forbidden worktree policy
write a credential, token, cookie, or password into the receipt or any evidence
repair a missing route, initialize a workspace, or provision a UAT account
stopConditions: no portable route declares the requested project and role
the hydrated route is missing, belongs to another Source, or disagrees with the closed portable route
the machine identity or its encrypted credential roster is unverified
the active checkout branch violates the routed Git mutation policy
the checkout is dirty outside the declared write roots
the observed checkout head differs from the mission-frozen head
the endpoint binding is not the closed workspace-route-port-projection or its fingerprint is stale
the runtime owner registry is missing, stale, or not ready while the caller must consume it
a resume adds no effective route, identity, runtime, or provenance delta
